Package index

Data & Exposure Setup

define_exposure()
Define DLNM exposure templates with flexible splines
check_identifiability()
Check DLNM cross-basis identifiability
build_design_matrix()
Build epidemic-level DLNM design matrix
prepare_response()
Prepare response variable for modeling

Model Fitting

fit_epidlnm()
Fit DLNM inferential model

Predictions & Simulations

predict_surface()
Predict full DLNM exposure-lag-response surface Computes the full DLNM exposure–lag–response surface using the fitted model,#' without refitting. The surface is evaluated over a grid of exposure values and lags defined by the model specification or user input.
predict_outcome()
Predict outcome under user-defined exposure-lag profile(s)
simulate_exposure()
Simulate exposure history across lags (full or patterned)
simulate_range()
Generate DLNM simulation scenarios (scenario or profile mode)
simulate_scenarios()
Simulate epidemiological DLNM scenarios
compare_exposures()
Compare exposure-lag profiles (pairwise or multiple)
compare_predictions()
Compare predicted outcomes between multiple exposure scenarios
compare_periods()
Compare accumulated DLNM effects between periods

Periods & Summaries

define_periods()
Define epidemiological lag periods
summarise_effects()
Summarise DLNM effects
recenter_effects()
Recenter DLNM effects using a new reference value
reduce_effects()
Reduce DLNM effects to one dimension (article-consistent)

Effect Decomposition & Analysis

compute_eci()
Compute Exposure Cumulative Impact (ECI - the exposure profile with the fitted model coefficients)
compute_ecilag()
Compute lag-specific decomposition of Exposure Cumulative Impact (ECI)
identify_critical_lags()
Identify critical lags based on daily DLNM effects
lag_contribution()
Quantify lag contributions to the cumulative DLNM effect
df_sensitivity()
Compute sensitivity of DLNM effects (analytical or finite derivative)
